title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree program in Computer Science or related STEM field
qualification: Experience in C++, Java, Python, or Go; strong foundation in data structures and algorithms
description: Join Google's engineering team for a 12-to-14 week summer internship working on real-world systems, cloud infrastructure, AI models, and user products.

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
eligibility: Graduate students, young professionals, and artists from eligible foreign countries
salary: Fully Funded (Tuition, monthly stipend, living expenses, airfare, health insurance)
qualification: Bachelor's degree or equivalent academic qualification, demonstrated leadership, English language proficiency
description: Enables international graduate students and young professionals to study, conduct research, and earn Master's or PhD degrees in the United States.

title: Junior Frontend Engineer
eligibility: Open globally to early-career developers with relevant experience
qualification: Proficiency in JavaScript, Vue.js or React, HTML/CSS, Git, and understanding of REST APIs
description: Help design, build, and maintain user interfaces across GitLab's DevOps platform as part of an all-remote, asynchronous global engineering team.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in high school, college, or university
salary: Grand Prize: $100,000 USD + Mentorship with Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella
qualification: Teams of up to 4 members building technology solutions leveraging Microsoft Azure AI capabilities
description: A global student technology competition encouraging young innovators to build impactful software projects that tackle real-world global issues using AI.

title: Associate AI Research Scientist
eligibility: Recent graduates or early-career professionals in CS, AI, Math, or Physics
qualification: Strong background in deep learning, linear algebra, PyTorch, and a track record of impactful projects or publications
description: Work alongside world-class researchers to train large AI models, improve safety alignment, and pioneer new architectures in artificial intelligence.

title: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to students and self-learners worldwide without prerequisites
description: An entry-level course that teaches algorithmic thinking and problem-solving using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript from Harvard professors.
